title: Video by earn.edits
description:
🧪 A 28-year-old lab worker died in Siberia. Within days, fears of a deadly plague were back 😨

🎬 This documentary-style motion piece turns a developing news story into a cinematic mystery. Reports said he died after developing severe pneumonia, rumors of a plague infection spread, and nearly 200 contacts were placed under medical observation. Then the investigation took a turn: Russian officials reported negative plague tests, and no outbreak was confirmed 🔍

🎞️ Built with atmospheric compositions, archival-inspired imagery, bold editorial typography, and carefully controlled pacing. Strategic transitions, dramatic sound design, and restrained color grading build an investigative mood without overwhelming the story

💭 So what actually caused his death? Sometimes the most compelling part of a mystery isn’t what we know
